newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI 97/98 1st half credit policy on April 15.
newsitem.headline: India RBI 97/98 1st half credit policy on April 15.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) will announce its monetary policy for the first half of 1997/98 (April-March) on April 15, an RBI spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
The monetary policy, also called credit policy, is expected to announce initiatives to prompt banks to lower lending rates and spur credit and industrial production, analysts said.
